title: 写一封有用的邀请邮件
stem: 你准备邀请交换生 Alex 参加学校读书会。写一封约 70—90 词的英文邮件，说明时间（周五 16:00）、地点（图书馆）、活动内容，并请 Alex 回复是否参加。不要写真实姓名或联系方式。
model:
Hi Alex,
Would you like to join our reading club this Friday? We will meet in the school library at four in the afternoon. Each person can bring a book and share one interesting part. You do not need to finish the whole book first. We will also help each other choose something new to read. I think it will be a good chance to meet our classmates. Please let me know if you can come.
Best wishes,
Li Hua
points: 时间、地点、活动和回复请求都写清楚
evidence: this Friday; in the school library; at four; let me know
strategy: 先列邀请必需的四件事，再用清楚的邮件顺序表达。
pitfall: 不要只介绍活动而忘记邀请与回复请求；时间和地点要让读者能直接行动。

title: 给同学的建议，具体才有用
stem: 同学 Sam 说自己每天想练英语，却常常不知道从哪里开始。写一段约 70—90 词的回复，给出两条可执行的建议，各说明一个理由，并以友好的话结尾。
model:
Hi Sam,
You do not need to do everything at once. First, choose five useful words and make a short sentence with each one. This helps you see how the words work. Second, read a short passage for ten minutes and write down one question about it. A small daily task is easier to keep doing than a long weekly one. You can put your plan beside your desk. Start with one step today, and give yourself time to improve.
points: 两条具体建议、对应理由和友好结尾
evidence: First ... This helps ... Second ... easier to keep doing
strategy: 每条建议配上一个理由，让读者知道做什么，也知道为什么。
pitfall: 只写 work harder 或 read more 不够具体；不要许诺几天内一定大幅提分。

title: 通知写清谁、何时、何地
stem: 学校准备周六 9:00—11:00 在校门口举行旧书交换活动。请写一则约 70—90 词的英文通知，面向全校学生，说明可带什么书、怎样交换，并提醒不要带损坏的书。可自行合理补充活动办法。
model:
BOOK EXCHANGE
Would you like to find a new book without buying one? Come to our book exchange at the school gate this Saturday, from 9 to 11 in the morning. Bring one or two books that you have finished reading. Please choose books in good condition. You can leave a short note about each book and then choose another book to take home. Do not bring damaged books. All students are welcome. Let's give our books a new reader!
points: 时间地点准确、参与对象清楚、交换办法可操作
evidence: this Saturday, from 9 to 11; Bring one or two books; choose another book
strategy: 先核对通知的行动信息，再补充规则和友好邀请。
pitfall: 活动办法可以补充，给定的时间和地点不能擅自改动。

title: 把一次改变写成完整经历
stem: 以 A small act of kindness 为题写约 80—100 词的短文。描述一次真实或合理虚构的助人经历，写清背景、你做了什么以及这件事带来的感受或变化。不要使用真实姓名。
model:
A small act of kindness
One afternoon, I saw a younger student standing outside the library. He looked worried because he could not find the book he needed. I was going home, but I stopped to help. We checked the shelf number together and found the book on a nearby table. He smiled and thanked me. The next week, I saw him helping another student in the same place. I learned that a small act can travel further than we expect. A few minutes of my time had become someone else's chance to help.
points: 背景、行动、结果或感受三部分完整
evidence: One afternoon ... We checked ... The next week ... I learned
strategy: 用时间顺序写清事情，再从结果中提炼具体感受。
pitfall: 不要大段写空泛道理，经历中的动作与变化才是支撑。

title: 表达观点，也给出理由
stem: 班级讨论是否每天安排十五分钟自由阅读。写约 90—110 词的英文发言稿，表明观点，给出两个理由，并回应一个可能的顾虑。题目不要求固定立场。
model: I support a daily fifteen-minute reading break. First, a regular time helps us build a habit. We are more likely to read when the time is already part of our day. Second, choosing our own books can make reading more enjoyable. Some classmates worry that the break will take time away from homework. I understand that concern, but fifteen focused minutes can also help us return to work with a calmer mind. We could try the plan for a month and then discuss what works. The aim is to make reading a useful part of school life.
points: 立场、两个理由和对一个顾虑的回应
evidence: I support ... First ... Second ... Some classmates worry ... but
strategy: 先写立场，再用理由支持，最后认真回应不同意见。
pitfall: 回应顾虑要解释或提出办法，不能只说不同意；也不要假造调查数字。

title: 活动报告：事实与建议分开
stem: 你班做了一次校园节水观察：午休时发现两处水龙头未关紧；图书馆门口的节水提示不明显；同学愿意轮流检查。写约 90—110 词的英文报告，概述发现并提出两条改进建议，不要编造统计数字。
model: Our class looked at water use around the school during the lunch break. We found two taps that were not fully turned off. We also noticed that the water-saving notice near the library entrance was difficult to see. Several classmates said they were willing to take turns checking the taps. We suggest making the notice clearer and placing it where students can easily read it. We could also organise a short daily check by volunteers. These steps would not cost much, but they could help us notice small problems before more water is wasted.
points: 三项观察如实表达，两条建议与问题对应
evidence: We found ... We also noticed ... We suggest ... also organise
strategy: 先报告观察到的事实，再把建议与具体问题对应。
pitfall: 没有调查数字就不添加比例；愿意参与不等于已经形成长期制度。

title: 用具体信息介绍自己
stem: 用英语说 30—45 秒：介绍一个自己的兴趣，说明平时怎么做，以及为什么喜欢。可以录音后回听，不要说真实姓名、学校或联系方式。
model: I enjoy drawing small things I see every day. I often take a notebook to the park and draw a leaf, a bench or a bird. I do not always finish a picture, but drawing helps me notice details. I like sharing my pictures with my family because they sometimes see things that I missed.
points: 兴趣、日常做法和理由都有表达
strategy: 先选一个兴趣，用一个具体例子支撑，再说理由。
pitfall: 不需要背长篇介绍。把三件事说清楚，比堆很多形容词更有用。

title: 按顺序复述一次小经历
stem: 读下面的情境，然后用英语说 40—60 秒，不必逐字翻译：周六你和朋友去公园；发现长椅旁有垃圾；一起清理并分类；后来有一位游客加入。说清经过和自己的感受。
model: Last Saturday, my friend and I went to the park. We found some litter beside a bench, so we decided to clean it up. We put paper and plastic into different bags. A visitor saw us and joined in. The work did not take long, but the area looked much better afterwards. I felt pleased because a small action had encouraged another person to help.
points: 四个情节顺序清楚，并说明感受
evidence: Last Saturday ... so ... joined in ... I felt
strategy: 先用时间和因果串起四个情节，再补一个真实的感受。
pitfall: 讲过去经历要注意过去式；不要为了说得快而把关键事件漏掉。

title: 把活动计划说得能照着做
stem: 你和同学准备周日下午做一个英语海报。说 40—60 秒，说明见面时间地点、各自带什么、怎样分工，并邀请同学提出意见。
model: Let's meet in the library at two on Sunday afternoon. I can bring some paper and coloured pens. Could you bring the notes we made in class? We can first choose three main ideas. Then I can draw the pictures while you write the short sentences. Before we finish, we should check the spelling together. What do you think of this plan?
points: 时间地点、物品、分工、征求意见
evidence: at two on Sunday ... bring ... while ... What do you think
strategy: 按见面、准备、分工、确认的顺序说，让同伴能直接回应。
pitfall: 不要只说 Let's make a poster；缺少时间地点或分工，计划就难以执行。

title: 比较两种出行方式
stem: 学校离家约三公里。说 45—60 秒，比较骑车和坐公交的各一个优点，结合天气或交通说明你今天的选择。没有唯一正确选择。
model: Cycling to school gives me some exercise, and I can leave when I am ready. Taking the bus is useful when the weather is bad, and I do not need to find a place for my bike. Today I would choose the bus because heavy rain is expected. I would leave a little earlier in case there is more traffic. On a dry day, I would probably cycle instead.
points: 两种方式都比较、今天选择明确、有情境理由
evidence: Cycling ... Taking the bus ... Today ... because
strategy: 先公平比较两种办法，再用今天的条件解释自己的选择。
pitfall: 不要把个人选择说成所有人都必须采用的规则。

title: 说出观点，回应不同想法
stem: 有人认为小组活动中应当总由英语最好的同学发言。说 45—60 秒，表明观点，给出两个理由，并提出一种让更多人参与的办法。
model: I do not think the strongest English speaker should always speak for the group. Everyone needs a chance to practise, and different people may have useful ideas. If only one person speaks, the others may stop preparing carefully. We could take turns and let the group help the speaker before the activity. For a difficult task, two students could share the speaking role. That way, the group can give a clear answer while more people learn.
points: 明确观点、两个理由、一个可执行办法
evidence: Everyone needs ... different people ... take turns
strategy: 用观点、理由、办法三层结构组织，避免只重复同一句主张。
pitfall: 表达不同意见时评价办法，不贬低同学；自查以清楚表达为目标，不模仿固定口音。

title: 向他人说明问题并求助
stem: 你在图书馆发现借来的书少了几页。向工作人员说 30—45 秒，说明发现问题的时间、缺页带来的影响，并礼貌地询问能否换一本。
model: Excuse me, I borrowed this book yesterday, and I have just noticed that a few pages are missing. I was reading the chapter about bridges, but I cannot follow the explanation without those pages. I checked my bag, and the pages are not there. Could I exchange it for another copy, please? If there is not one available, could you suggest a similar book?
points: 问题与时间清楚、影响具体、请求礼貌
evidence: borrowed ... yesterday; pages are missing; Could I ... please
strategy: 先陈述事实，再解释影响，最后提出具体、礼貌的请求。
pitfall: 不要在没有证据时指责别人；请求要让对方知道怎样帮助你。
